role: The world's named game rules (doFireTick, mobGriefing, keepInventory, doMobSpawning, doMobLoot, doTileDrops, commandBlockOutput, naturalRegeneration, doDaylightCycle) as string values in a TreeMap, saved to level.dat.

members.name: theGameRules
members.note: no map; each consulted rule is a separate int read from the snapshot's GameRules NBT

members.name: GameRules
members.note: defaults are assumed in code comments (mobGriefing, doMobLoot, naturalRegeneration true)

members.name: setOrCreateGameRule
members.note: dev.c's gamerule op handles doDaylightCycle and keepInventory only

members.name: getGameRuleBooleanValue
members.note: doFireTick, doMobSpawning, keepInventory, doDaylightCycle are read; mobGriefing, doMobLoot, doTileDrops, naturalRegeneration are hard-wired to their defaults

members.name: readGameRulesFromNBT
members.note: serverreplay.c reads doFireTick, doMobSpawning, keepInventory from the snapshot worldinfo

notes: Whether servertick.c reads doDaylightCycle from the snapshot (vs only via dev.c) I did not confirm. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): only default rule values and the two dev-op rules are reachable (no commands); writing them is the deferred save side. Formerly listed as missing: mobGriefing, doMobLoot, doTileDrops and naturalRegeneration are fixed at true in native; a world with any of them false would diverge. Game rules are not written back to NBT natively (writeGameRulesToNBT).
